method: Read from raw files only (no report numbers): each turn's SSE (response.sse or .gz) is parsed into content, reasoning, tool_calls (id, name, concatenated arguments) and finish_reason; each tool file must carry the same provider id, name and arguments and a content SHA-256 that matches its content; the next turn's request.json must echo the same assistant tool_calls and carry one role tool message per call with the same tool_call_id and byte-identical content; the last turn must end finish stop with content equal to response.txt; request and response bytes are hashed against observation.json. Script: artifacts/v5-p7-f1-v6-d4-contractfix/tools/f1q_chain_verify.py.

exceptions.finding: request.json SHA differs from observation.json for turns 1-2; the directory holds request.redaction.json (approved PII redaction of D05 request bodies, 2026-10-10). Tool ids, arguments, tool-message content identity and the final answer all verify.

conclusion: On qwen/qwen3.7-flash via Alibaba, with stream true and reasoning enabled true in every request, Qwen did emit native tool_calls (45 turns, all finish tool_calls, tool_choice auto); the C# handler ran (each call has a tool file); the next request carried every result under the same tool_call_id with byte-identical content; and the request ended with a stop answer. In the Issue #5 experiment this happened only in the mandatory-evidence arm (9/10 requests, 28/28 results OK); the optional-tools arm made 0 calls in 10 requests.
